selection: all matching build profiles on the shared connection since g540 installation; incidents are retained, including worker replacement without transport reconnect
limits: Different workloads, observation windows, pressure and sample counts; regression in observed timings does not prove the g540 change caused it.
Source heartbeat failure is one incident; timing/error labels are not separate incidents. It caused a joined worker replacement, not a retained TLS reconnect or error-1066 service stop.
Source query phase scheduled identifies rejection before its callback reached checking; it does not establish a slow SCM native call.
Native IPC stage maxima describe per-entry worst-dispatch frames, not every ACK.
System busy snapshots end before the later source retirement and worst capture; they show earlier pressure, not causally matched CPU attribution.
FirstOfferSinceBegin includes source input availability and is not measured cursor or round-trip latency.
Do not add nested intervals or subtract device wall clocks. Historical control.previous logs are incomplete.
